name: ShizuWall
description: Lightweight, no vpn firewall solution for Android 11+
readme_summary: ShizuWall is a lightweight, privacy-focused Android firewall application for Android 11+ that allows per-app network control without using a VPN. It operates locally and supports control via Shizuku, a local ADB daemon, or root access, making it suitable for automation.
key_features: Automation ready via ADB broadcast commands
Multiple control methods (Quick Settings, Widget, Floating Button)
primary_use_case: To provide users with granular control over which applications can access the network on their Android device, enhancing privacy and enabling automation, without the complexities or side effects of a traditional VPN.
cover_image_prompt: A digital illustration of a vigilant Android robot standing guard at a city gate. Each app on the city's network is represented by a small, distinct building. The robot is holding a glowing, translucent shield that selectively blocks or allows data streams (represented by glowing lines) to enter or leave each building. Some streams are blocked with a red 'X', while others pass through with a green checkmark. Subtle UI elements resembling firewall rules and network status indicators are visible on the robot's shield. The background is a clean, modern cityscape with a soft glow. The style is 3D isometric illustration with clear iconography and a vibrant, tech-inspired color palette.

name: Final2x
readme_summary: Final2x is a cross-platform desktop application designed for image super-resolution. It leverages advanced computer vision models, including those powered by PyTorch and a custom backend (cccv), to enhance image quality and detail, making it suitable for various operating systems like Windows, macOS, and Linux.
key_features: Image super-resolution using advanced AI models
Customizable model support via cccv backend
Vue3 and TypeScript for the frontend
primary_use_case: Enhancing the resolution and quality of digital images using AI-powered super-resolution techniques.
cover_image_prompt: A digital artist's workbench where a low-resolution, pixelated image of a majestic eagle is being fed into a glowing, futuristic device labeled 'Final2x'. The device emits beams of light that transform the eagle into a stunningly sharp, high-resolution image, with intricate feather details clearly visible. Surrounding the device are subtle UI elements showing progress bars and model selection, and small floating data particles. The overall mood is one of creative enhancement and technological magic, rendered in a clean, 3D isometric illustration style with a vibrant color palette.

name: skitter-creek-bath-salts
description: Unlocking _everything_ on the CPU with DRAM scrambling
readme_summary: This C repository, skitter-creek-bath-salts, manipulates the DRAM controller to remap physical memory addresses. By breaking the standard address translations, it exposes protected and hidden regions of DRAM, effectively bypassing kernel-level security and unlocking access to all memory.
primary_use_case: To gain low-level, unrestricted access to all system memory by manipulating DRAM address translations, bypassing security mechanisms.
cover_image_prompt: A master locksmith, with a determined expression, is using a glowing, intricate key to unlock a massive, multi-layered vault door that represents a computer's memory. Instead of traditional tumblers, the vault's mechanism is composed of glowing circuit board traces and abstract data streams. As the key turns, sections of the vault door swing open, revealing hidden chambers filled with shimmering data. Subtle elements like small, stylized code snippets and abstract representations of CPU cores are visible in the background. The scene is set in a dimly lit, futuristic workshop, with the vault door being the primary light source. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a focus on intricate details and a dramatic, high-contrast color palette of blues, purples, and golds.

name: pentestcode
description: PentestCode - Multi-agent AI penetration testing system with persistent engagement state, strategic coordination, and parallel autonomous operations.
readme_summary: PentestCode is an autonomous AI penetration testing agent designed for terminal use. It employs a multi-agent architecture to perform comprehensive security assessments, tracking engagement state and coordinating parallel operations.
key_features: Support for 20+ LLM providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Azure, AWS Bedrock, Ollama, etc.)
Structured state for querying scan results, vulnerabilities, and credentials
Automated attack chain execution from initial instruction to exploitation
Self-contained binary installation for Linux and macOS
primary_use_case: Automating penetration testing engagements by providing an AI agent that can autonomously scan, enumerate, attack, and exploit targets based on high-level instructions.
cover_image_prompt: A highly skilled cybersecurity operative, depicted as a master strategist, orchestrating a complex digital infiltration from a futuristic command center. Instead of a single agent, visualize a swarm of specialized robotic drones, each representing an AI agent, simultaneously scanning a network represented by glowing circuit pathways and data streams. One drone deploys a digital lockpick, another analyzes data packets, and a third cracks a code. The command center displays a dynamic, evolving map of the target network, highlighting vulnerabilities as red nodes and successful breaches as green ones. The overall mood is one of focused, intelligent, and coordinated action. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a dark, high-tech aesthetic, emphasizing the multi-agent coordination and the automated attack chain.

name: awesome-generative-ai-apps
description: 50+ open-source generative AI apps you can clone, deploy, and monetize — image generators, video tools, virtual try-ons, AI SaaS templates, and platform integrations. One-click Vercel deploy on every template.
readme_summary: This repository provides over 50 open-source generative AI applications that users can clone, deploy, and monetize. Each application is a complete SaaS product with integrated authentication, billing, and AI functionalities, designed for easy deployment on platforms like Vercel.
key_features: Integrated Stripe Billing and Google OAuth
Credit billing model with high profit margins
Includes image generators, video tools, virtual try-ons, and more
primary_use_case: To provide developers and entrepreneurs with ready-to-launch, monetizable generative AI SaaS applications that can be quickly deployed and branded as their own.
cover_image_prompt: A vibrant, stylized marketplace stall overflowing with diverse, ready-to-sell AI-powered products like image generators, video creators, and virtual try-on booths. A friendly entrepreneur is cheerfully handing a 'Sold!' sign to a customer, with a small, glowing 'Clone & Deploy' button subtly integrated into the stall's counter. In the background, a Vercel logo is visible on a distant building, signifying easy deployment. The overall scene should feel abundant, accessible, and profitable, rendered in a clean, 3D isometric illustration style with bright, inviting colors and clear iconography.
